scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; npm/*) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; *) if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ] || [ -f pnpm-workspace.yaml ]; then exit 0; fi; echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./backend/**" --filter "./frontend/**" --if-present run typecheck
